journal_entry: I barely slept last night. I feel worthless and nothing will change. I haven't painted in weeks.
I can’t stop pacing. Something bad will happen tomorrow. I skipped the party because I was too nervous.
They’d be better off without me. I left letters for my friends. I sleep all day now.
The car runs because I think about jellyfish. I wore a coat in summer and forgot to eat.
